title: Glowing flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M28 60 L34 88 L66 88 L72 60 Z' fill='#C4522A'/>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='24' y='54' width='52' height='9' rx='3' fill='#E8743A'/>
  <!-- pot highlight -->
  <path d='M32 63 L36 84 L42 84 L38 63 Z' fill='#E88B5C' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='23' ry='7' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#7A5230'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='48' y='30' width='4' height='28' rx='2' fill='#2E8B3A'/>
  <!-- leaf left -->
  <path d='M48 40 Q30 32 26 44 Q36 48 48 44 Z' fill='#3CB34A'/>
  <!-- leaf right -->
  <path d='M52 36 Q70 28 74 40 Q64 44 52 40 Z' fill='#3CB34A'/>
  <!-- glowing flower petals -->
  <g fill='#FFD84D'>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='6' ry='10'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(60 50 18)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(120 50 18)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(180 50 18)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(240 50 18)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='6' ry='10' transform='rotate(300 50 18)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- petal glow ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='14' fill='#FFE87A' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- flower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='6' fill='#FF9B2E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='3' fill='#FFD84D'/>
  <!-- glow aura around flower -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='20' fill='#FFD84D' opacity='0.15'/>
  <!-- pot glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#FF9B2E' opacity='0.25'/>
</svg>
